entry.title: Mole Antonelliana
entry.note: Exact-QID outline places its approximately 29 m projecting entrance portico on local −Z and the broad 50 m rear wings on +Z. The authored plan preserves that asymmetry, resolving the minimum-rectangle half-turn ambiguity. The roughly 29 m mapped portico and broad rear wings agree with the authored footprint. Exact paving joints and the sloping street edge are not modeled. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
